slots.th: table-cell w-[var(--arena-column-width,auto)] px-row-px py-row-py [text-align:var(--arena-column-align,left)] align-middle font-face-label text-label font-bold tracking-label-role case-label text-ink-muted/(--level-ink-muted) border-b-[length:var(--bw-separator)] border-edge-separator outline-none focus:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_var(--focus-width)_var(--focus-ring)]
slots.pager: flex justify-end border-t-[length:var(--bw-separator)] border-edge-separator px-row-px py-row-py
slots.row: table-row border-t-[length:var(--bw-separator)] border-edge-separator transition-[background] duration-[var(--dur-hover)] ease-hover
slots.td: table-cell w-[var(--arena-column-width,auto)] px-row-px py-row-py [text-align:var(--arena-column-align,left)] align-middle text-ctl outline-none focus:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_var(--focus-width)_var(--focus-ring)]
slots.link: inline-flex items-center min-h-ctl-h-sm cursor-pointer no-underline rounded-control outline-none transition-[color] duration-[var(--dur-hover)] ease-hover hover:text-ink-body focus:shadow-[inset_0_0_0_var(--focus-width)_var(--focus-ring)]
slots.empty: px-4 py-8 text-center align-middle text-ctl text-ink-muted/(--level-ink-muted)
slots.card: flex flex-col gap-stack bg-surface border-[length:var(--bw-surface)] border-edge-surface rounded-surface p-row-px shadow-surface-rest
slots.cardLabel: font-face-label text-label font-bold tracking-label-role case-label text-ink-muted/(--level-ink-muted)
slots.cardBlock: w-full flex justify-end gap-2 border-t-[length:var(--bw-separator)] border-edge-separator pt-2

internal.narrow: the table is narrower than the md breakpoint and responsive
internal.first: the first row of the body (rowIndex <= 1), which draws no rule above itself
